why: V2-R17 C: this records that the deterministic point-shuffle was ENABLED AT RUN TIME. The failure it guards is not "the code was never fixed" but "the code was fixed and the run did not switch it on" -- the same family as reporting an unstarted run as started. A freeze gate must FAIL if CATOSG_EVAL_RNG is not 1.

collision_scan.scope: every (split, scene, frame, cav) identity in validate + test + culver
collision_scan.why: A collision is a SILENT failure: two identities share a seed, products stay deterministic, every other check passes, and two frames point orders become correlated. At 32 bits and ~18k identities the birthday probability is a few per cent, so this is enumerated rather than assumed.
collision_scan.remedy_if_nonzero: SHA-256 first 16 bytes -> 4 uint32 -> RandomState (2^128 seed space, still MT19937). NOT per-case salting: that turns a rule into a table of exceptions.

note: The three OpenCOOD edits live in the SIBLING checkout, which is not part of this git repository and is not pushed anywhere. A machine without them cannot reproduce these products.
